title: Uncle Vincent listed as a musician but really a grocer
summary: Vincent was a clarinetist but an amateur in the sense that grocery was his livelihood.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

But even primarily, he was a grocer.
